SELECT 
  product_group_name,
  SUM(product_quantity) AS quantity_sold,
  SUM(total_amount) AS total_revenue,
  EXTRACT(YEAR FROM invoice_date) AS year
FROM 
  master_sale
WHERE 
  invoice_date >= '2020-01-01'
GROUP BY 
  product_group_name, 
  EXTRACT(YEAR FROM invoice_date)
